## Codebase Overview

### Scope and evidence basis
This overview is derived from direct inspection of repository source/config/manifests/routes (not inferred behavior from external context).

Primary anchors:
- Project framing: [README.md](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/README.md), [AGENTS.md](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/AGENTS.md)
- Runtime/composition: [bootstrap/app.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/bootstrap/app.php), [bootstrap/providers.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/bootstrap/providers.php)
- HTTP surfaces: [routes/api.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/api.php), [routes/web.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/web.php), [routes/console.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/console.php), [routes/channels.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/channels.php)
- Dependency manifests: [composer.json](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/composer.json), [package.json](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/package.json), [package-lock.json](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/package-lock.json)

### Project purpose
The repository is a local-first Laravel application for orchestrating and operating scheduled AI/agent workflows. The core purpose is not just cron scheduling, but a broader “agent operations platform” that includes:
- Scheduled job definition/execution and run lifecycle management.
- Requirements discovery/interrogation workflows.
- Messenger-based control plane (Slack/Telegram/Discord/WhatsApp connectors).
- Memory subsystem for contextual retrieval and persistence.
- Delegation and org-layer orchestration features.
- Code analysis/reporting pipelines and docs tooling.

Evidence:
- [README.md](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/README.md) explicitly positions “Agent Ops” and lists scheduler/monitor/discovery/messenger capabilities.
- Domain models and routes show expansion beyond simple scheduling, e.g. [app/Models](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Models), [routes/api.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/api.php), [routes/web.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/web.php).

### Overall architecture
The architecture is Laravel MVC plus a substantial service/support layer and asynchronous workflow orchestration.

1. Application composition and boundaries
- App bootstraps web/api/console/channels in one entrypoint, with custom API exception envelopes scoped to `/agent/api/v1/*`.
- Sanctum stateful API is enabled; feature-gate middleware aliases (`delegation`, `org`, and UI variants) are registered centrally.
- Service providers include app core, auth stack, Horizon, memory, and messenger.

Evidence: [bootstrap/app.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/bootstrap/app.php), [bootstrap/providers.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/bootstrap/providers.php), [app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php).

2. API/Web surface partitioning
- Versioned JSON API under `/agent/api/v1` with authenticated operational routes and unauthenticated connector webhook routes protected by middleware.
- Inertia web routes provide operator UIs for jobs, monitor, tools, discovery wizard, code analysis, memory, messenger health/dead letters, org, and delegation.

Evidence: [routes/api.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/api.php), [routes/web.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/web.php).

3. Async-first execution model
- Scheduler enqueues recurring operational commands (dispatch/prune/backup/messenger/delegation/NL cleanup/memory/code-analysis/org dispatch).
- Queue/Horizon define dedicated queues and supervisors for agent, interrogation, messenger, delegation, memory, org rituals, and code-analysis.
- Run execution jobs perform process orchestration, lifecycle transitions, output streaming, timeout/stop handling, and post-run policies.

Evidence: [routes/console.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/console.php), [config/queue.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/config/queue.php), [config/horizon.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/config/horizon.php), [app/Jobs/ExecuteAgentRunJob.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Jobs/ExecuteAgentRunJob.php).

4. Realtime/evented layer
- Broadcast channels exist for interrogation, delegation graphs/user summaries, code-analysis sessions, and memory diagnostics.
- Frontend uses Laravel Echo with Reverb transport.
- Event/listener pattern is applied across delegation and documentation telemetry.

Evidence: [routes/channels.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/channels.php), [resources/js/bootstrap.js](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/bootstrap.js), [config/broadcasting.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/config/broadcasting.php), [config/reverb.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/config/reverb.php), [app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php).

5. Domain modularization
- `app/Support/*` is the main domain/service layer, split into: Agent, Compliance, Delegation, Documentation, Interrogation, Memory, Messenger, NlSchedule, Org, RepoAnalysis, TaskProviders.
- `app/Jobs/*` mirrors module decomposition for asynchronous execution.
- `app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/*` is organized by module (`Docs`, `Memory`, `Messenger`, `Org`, etc.).

Evidence: directory structure from `find` under [app](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app).

6. Data model footprint
- 62 Eloquent models and 89 migrations were observed, spanning scheduler, interrogation, chat/messenger, memory, delegation, org, docs, repo-analysis, notifications, and user prefs.

Evidence: [app/Models](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Models), [database/migrations](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/database/migrations).

### Tech stack
Backend/runtime:
- PHP `^8.2`, Laravel Framework `^12.0`.
- Laravel Jetstream + Fortify + Sanctum for auth/account/security flows.
- Horizon for queue workers.
- Reverb for websocket broadcasting.
- Scout + Typesense for search.
- Pennant for feature-flag support package presence.

Evidence: [composer.json](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/composer.json), [config/scout.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/config/scout.php), [config/broadcasting.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/config/broadcasting.php).

Frontend/build:
- Vue 3 + Inertia (`@inertiajs/vue3`) with SSR entry.
- Vite 7 + `laravel-vite-plugin` + `@vitejs/plugin-vue`.
- Tailwind packages present (`@tailwindcss/forms`, `@tailwindcss/typography`, `@tailwindcss/vite`).
- Markdown/editor utilities (`@crazydos/vue-markdown`, TipTap packages, `remark-gfm`).
- Realtime client (`laravel-echo`, `pusher-js`) and HTTP (`axios`).

Evidence: [package.json](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/package.json), [resources/js/app.js](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/app.js), [resources/js/ssr.js](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/ssr.js), [vite.config.js](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/vite.config.js).

Infra/config defaults:
- `.env.example` defaults to PostgreSQL (`DB_CONNECTION=pgsql`), Redis queue/cache, Reverb broadcast, Scout Typesense, Sanctum stateful domains.
- Queue default is configurable; project-local default shows database in config, but `.env.example` sets `QUEUE_CONNECTION=redis`.

Evidence: [.env.example](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/.env.example), [config/database.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/config/database.php), [config/queue.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/config/queue.php).

## Backend Architecture, Data Model, and Routing

### Inspection method (step-by-step)
1. Inspected application boot/composition and provider wiring in [bootstrap/app.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/bootstrap/app.php) and [bootstrap/providers.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/bootstrap/providers.php).
2. Inspected HTTP/API/channel/console surfaces in [routes/api.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/api.php), [routes/web.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/web.php), [routes/channels.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/channels.php), and [routes/console.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/console.php).
3. Inspected backend layering and policies in [app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php), feature/security middleware under [app/Http/Middleware](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Middleware), and queue settings in [config/queue.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/config/queue.php) and [config/horizon.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/config/horizon.php).
4. Inspected domain modules under [app/Support](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support), async jobs under [app/Jobs](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Jobs), and events/listeners under [app/Events](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Events) and [app/Listeners](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Listeners).
5. Inspected data model and schema via [app/Models](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Models) and [database/migrations](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/database/migrations), with targeted reads for key tables.

### 1) Backend architecture: layered domain structure

The backend is a Laravel 12 monolith with clear module partitioning by domain and strong async orchestration.

- Bootstrapping centralizes route wiring, middleware aliasing, and API exception envelopes in [bootstrap/app.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/bootstrap/app.php).
- Provider registration is explicit in [bootstrap/providers.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/bootstrap/providers.php): `AppServiceProvider`, `FortifyServiceProvider`, `HorizonServiceProvider`, `JetstreamServiceProvider`, `MemoryServiceProvider`, `MessengerServiceProvider`.
- Domain logic is concentrated in `app/Support/*` modules rather than controllers. Observed module roots include:
`Agent`, `Compliance`, `Delegation`, `Documentation`, `Interrogation`, `Memory`, `Messenger`, `NlSchedule`, `Notifications`, `Org`, `RepoAnalysis`, `TaskProviders` in [app/Support](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support).
- Async execution is split into module-specific jobs in [app/Jobs](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Jobs), including nested domains (`Memory`, `Messenger`, `Org`, `RepoAnalysis`, `Documentation`).
- API controllers are grouped by version and domain in [app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1) with subfolders for `Docs`, `Memory`, `Messenger`, and `Org`.

#### App-level policy, DI, and governance wiring
From [app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php):
- DI bindings include `OrchestrationPolicyServiceContract -> OrchestrationPolicyService` and docs search/index abstractions.
- Event subscribers are registered for delegation and documentation telemetry.
- Policy mappings are registered for key models (agent jobs/runs, delegation graphs, interrogation sessions, org entities, repo analysis sessions, audit logs).
- Rate limiters are defined for `agent-mutations`, `interrogation`, `memory-reads`, and `memory-writes`.
- Authorization gates for docs diagnostics/coverage and NL parse telemetry are defined.

#### Feature gates and security middleware
- API versioning header middleware: [app/Http/Middleware/AgentApiVersionHeader.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Middleware/AgentApiVersionHeader.php) (`X-Agent-Api-Version: 1.0`).
- Feature gates: [app/Http/Middleware/DelegationFeatureGate.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Middleware/DelegationFeatureGate.php), [app/Http/Middleware/DelegationUiFeatureGate.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Middleware/DelegationUiFeatureGate.php), [app/Http/Middleware/OrgFeatureGate.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Middleware/OrgFeatureGate.php), [app/Http/Middleware/OrgUiFeatureGate.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Middleware/OrgUiFeatureGate.php), [app/Http/Middleware/Memory/MemoryEnabled.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Middleware/Memory/MemoryEnabled.php).
- Webhook hardening middleware: [app/Http/Middleware/Messenger/VerifyWebhookSignature.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Middleware/Messenger/VerifyWebhookSignature.php), [app/Http/Middleware/Messenger/ReplayProtection.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Middleware/Messenger/ReplayProtection.php), [app/Http/Middleware/Messenger/CorrelationId.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Middleware/Messenger/CorrelationId.php).

### 2) Routing and API surfaces

#### API surface topology
All primary JSON routes are versioned under `/agent/api/v1` in [routes/api.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/api.php), wrapped with `AgentApiVersionHeader` and mostly protected by `auth:sanctum` + `verified`.

Observed authenticated API domains:
- Agent jobs/runs: `AgentJobController`, `AgentRunController`.
- Agent ops settings: `AgentBackupSettingsController`, `AgentFeatureSettingsController`.
- Dashboard/health: `AgentDashboardController`, `AgentHealthController`.
- Notifications: `NotificationController`.
- Compliance: `ComplianceController`.
- Documentation: `DocsSearchController`, `DocsFragmentController`, `DocsCoverageController`, `DiagnosticsController`.
- Interrogation: `InterrogationSessionController`, `InterrogationSettingsController`, `InterrogationTechStackController`, `InterrogationTaskProviderController`.
- Repo analysis: `RepoAnalysisSessionController`.
- Chat/messenger API: `ChatSessionController`, `ChatActionController`, `MessengerConnectorController`, `MessengerHealthController`, `MessengerMetricsController`.
- Memory API: `MemorySettingsController`, `MemoryRetrievalController`, `MemoryCoreBlockController`, `MemoryWorkingController`, `MemoryDiagnosticsController`.
- Org API (gated by `org`): `OrgAgentController`, `OrgRitualController`, `OrgRitualRunController`, `OrgCouncilController`, `OrgCostController`, `OrgEscalationController`.
- Delegation API (gated by `delegation`): `DelegationGraphController`, `DelegationTaskController`, `DelegateeProfileController`.

Observed unauthenticated ingress endpoints in [routes/api.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/api.php):
- Connector webhooks under `/connectors/{provider}/webhook` for Slack, Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp.
- Middleware chain on webhook routes: correlation ID, signature verification, replay protection.
- Internal schedule parse endpoint under `/internal/api/schedule/parse`.

#### Web route surface
From [routes/web.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/web.php):
- Public routes: welcome page, account-link page, public messenger health endpoint.
- Authenticated/verified operator UI routes (Inertia) for dashboard, jobs, monitor, docs pages, tools pages.
- Tools UIs include discovery, code analysis, backup settings, feature settings, messenger health/dead letters, memory pages.
- Org UI routes are grouped behind `org.ui` middleware.
- Delegation UI routes are grouped behind `delegation.ui` middleware.

#### Broadcast channels
From [routes/channels.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/channels.php):
- `interrogation.{sessionId}`
- `delegation.graph.{graphId}`
- `delegation.user.{userId}`
- `code-analysis.{sessionId}`
- `memory.diagnostics.{userId}`

#### Scheduled console orchestration
From [routes/console.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/console.php):
- Every-minute dispatch and operational maintenance (`agent:dispatch-due`, backup, prune commands).
- Dedicated schedulers for messenger cleanup, delegation reconciliation/metric recompute, NL parse cleanup.
- Memory maintenance schedules (`memory:consolidate`, `memory:prune`).
- Repo analysis artifact pruning schedule.

## Frontend Architecture and UI Patterns

### Evidence Basis and Inspection Scope
This section is based on direct repository inspection of frontend entrypoints, page components, shared components, styles, routes, and relevant backend controllers/middleware used by the UI.

Primary anchors:
- Frontend boot/SSR/runtime wiring: [resources/js/app.js](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/app.js), [resources/js/ssr.js](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/ssr.js), [resources/js/bootstrap.js](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/bootstrap.js), [resources/views/app.blade.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/views/app.blade.php)
- Route-to-page mapping: [routes/web.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/web.php), [routes/api.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/api.php), [routes/channels.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/channels.php)
- Shared Inertia props and feature gates: [app/Http/Middleware/HandleInertiaRequests.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Middleware/HandleInertiaRequests.php)
- UI shell and cross-cutting behavior: [resources/js/Layouts/AppLayout.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Layouts/AppLayout.vue)
- Styling system: [tailwind.config.js](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/tailwind.config.js), [resources/css/theme.css](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/css/theme.css), [resources/css/app.css](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/css/app.css)

### 1) Frontend Runtime Architecture
- The app is an Inertia + Vue 3 application with both client and SSR entrypoints. Client boot resolves pages dynamically via `import.meta.glob('./Pages/**/*.vue')`, and SSR uses the same page resolver path, keeping route/component identity aligned between CSR and SSR. Evidence: [resources/js/app.js](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/app.js), [resources/js/ssr.js](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/ssr.js).
- Routing helpers are injected via Ziggy in both CSR and SSR, with SSR explicitly hydrating URL location from page props (`page.props.ziggy.location`). Evidence: [resources/js/app.js](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/app.js), [resources/js/ssr.js](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/ssr.js), [app/Http/Middleware/HandleInertiaRequests.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Middleware/HandleInertiaRequests.php).
- Realtime infrastructure is initialized globally: `window.Echo` uses Reverb transport settings from `VITE_REVERB_*` env vars. Evidence: [resources/js/bootstrap.js](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/bootstrap.js).
- The Blade root template pre-applies theme class and color scheme before Vue mount (using `agent-theme-preference`) to avoid flash/mismatch at startup, then loads Inertia/Vite assets including route metadata via `@routes`. Evidence: [resources/views/app.blade.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/views/app.blade.php).

### 2) Page Structure and Route Surface
- Page tree is organized by functional domains under `resources/js/Pages`: `Agent`, `Tools`, `Docs`, `Messenger`, `API`, `Profile`, `Auth`. Evidence: [resources/js/Pages](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Pages).
- Server routes map directly to Inertia pages (closure-rendered or controller-rendered) rather than client-side router declarations. Examples:
- Jobs/Monitor: `/agent/jobs*`, `/agent/monitor` -> `Agent/Jobs/*`, `Agent/Monitor/Index`. Evidence: [routes/web.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/web.php).
- Tooling: `/tools/discovery*`, `/tools/messenger`, `/tools/memory*`, `/tools/code-analysis*`, `/tools/features/settings`, `/tools/backups/settings`. Evidence: [routes/web.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/web.php).
- Docs pages: `/docs`, `/docs/{slug}` are server-driven by a docs controller and rendered via Inertia pages (`Docs/Index`, `Docs/Show`). Evidence: [routes/web.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/web.php), [app/Http/Controllers/Docs/DocsPageController.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Controllers/Docs/DocsPageController.php).
- Feature-gated page availability is enforced at route layer for key surfaces (not only hidden in UI), especially Code Analysis and Org/Delegation route groups. Evidence: [routes/web.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/web.php).

### 3) Global Shell and Navigation Pattern
- A single shell component drives top-level UX, navigation, theme controls, notifications, responsive nav, and account/team menus: [resources/js/Layouts/AppLayout.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Layouts/AppLayout.vue).
- The shell conditionally exposes Delegation and Org navigation from server-shared feature flags (`$page.props.delegationEnabled`, `$page.props.orgLayerEnabled`). Evidence: [resources/js/Layouts/AppLayout.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Layouts/AppLayout.vue), [app/Http/Middleware/HandleInertiaRequests.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Middleware/HandleInertiaRequests.php).
- Notification UX is centralized in the shell and delegated to a focused presentational component. Shell fetches/polls/mutates data; drawer emits UI intents. Evidence: [resources/js/Layouts/AppLayout.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Layouts/AppLayout.vue), [resources/js/Components/NotificationDrawer.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Components/NotificationDrawer.vue), [app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/NotificationController.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/NotificationController.php).
- Global confirm dialogs are implemented as a shared reactive service + shell-mounted modal host. Evidence: [resources/js/Support/confirmDialog.js](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Support/confirmDialog.js), [resources/js/Components/AppConfirmDialog.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Components/AppConfirmDialog.vue), [resources/js/Layouts/AppLayout.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Layouts/AppLayout.vue).

### 4) Component Architecture and Reuse Patterns
- The UI uses a lightweight primitive layer (`Button`, `Input`, `Select`, `Card*`, `Table*`, `Badge`, `Skeleton`, `Spinner`) with tokenized class conventions and small prop surfaces. Evidence: [resources/js/Components/ui/Button.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Components/ui/Button.vue), [resources/js/Components/ui/Input.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Components/ui/Input.vue), [resources/js/Components/ui/Select.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Components/ui/Select.vue), [resources/js/Components/ui/utils.js](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Components/ui/utils.js).
- Domain-specific composition is concentrated in feature component folders:
- Interrogation components (question rendering, phase stepper, build panel, status/summary/plan views). Evidence: [resources/js/Components/Interrogation](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Components/Interrogation).
- Code analysis components (task graph, coverage, report/artifact views). Evidence: [resources/js/Components/CodeAnalysis](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Components/CodeAnalysis).
- Markdown handling is a first-class shared concern:
- Read path uses sanitized markdown rendering with GFM and external-link hardening. Evidence: [resources/js/Components/Markdown/MarkdownRenderer.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Components/Markdown/MarkdownRenderer.vue).
- Write path uses TipTap markdown mode and emits markdown text back to parents. Evidence: [resources/js/Components/Markdown/MarkdownEditor.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Components/Markdown/MarkdownEditor.vue).
- `HelpHint` is a reusable progressive-help component used across pages. It supports inline text and remote docs-fragment lookup with timeout/silent-fail behavior. Evidence: [resources/js/Components/HelpHint.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Components/HelpHint.vue), [app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Docs/DocsFragmentController.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Docs/DocsFragmentController.php).
- Jetstream-provided account/API-token sections coexist with custom UI primitives, indicating a hybrid component ecosystem rather than full replacement. Evidence: [resources/js/Pages/Profile/Show.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Pages/Profile/Show.vue), [resources/js/Pages/API/Partials/ApiTokenManager.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Pages/API/Partials/ApiTokenManager.vue).

### 5) State and Data Flow Patterns
- State is predominantly page-local (`ref`, `reactive`, `computed`) with explicit `load`/`save`/`action` functions per page.
- No centralized frontend store pattern is evident in repo structure (`resources/js` has no `store`/`pinia` area) and grep over `resources/js` found no `createPinia`/`defineStore` usage.
- Inertia shared props are the cross-page state channel for auth/team info, route info, feature flags, and initial notifications. Evidence: [app/Http/Middleware/HandleInertiaRequests.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Middleware/HandleInertiaRequests.php), [resources/js/Layouts/AppLayout.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Layouts/AppLayout.vue).
- Standard async flow in list/config pages is: `onMounted(load)` -> axios call -> local refs update -> action handlers call API then reload data. Evidence: [resources/js/Pages/Agent/Jobs/Index.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Pages/Agent/Jobs/Index.vue), [resources/js/Pages/Tools/Features/Settings.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Pages/Tools/Features/Settings.vue), [resources/js/Pages/Tools/Backups/Settings.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Pages/Tools/Backups/Settings.vue).
- Error-handling convention in multiple pages expects backend envelope shape `error.message` and optional `error.details`, with fallback text if absent. Evidence: [resources/js/Pages/Agent/Jobs/Create.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Pages/Agent/Jobs/Create.vue), [resources/js/Pages/Agent/Jobs/Edit.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Pages/Agent/Jobs/Edit.vue), [resources/js/Pages/Tools/CodeAnalysis/Create.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Pages/Tools/CodeAnalysis/Create.vue).
- Complex surfaces combine polling + websocket + merge logic:
- Monitor uses adaptive polling intervals based on visibility/focus and failure backoff; event tails are incremental with sequence cursor and dedupe. Evidence: [resources/js/Pages/Agent/Monitor/Index.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Pages/Agent/Monitor/Index.vue).
- Discovery wizard polls every ~3s and subscribes to private interrogation channel events; merges event streams and refreshes session state based on event type. Evidence: [resources/js/Pages/Tools/Discovery/Wizard.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Pages/Tools/Discovery/Wizard.vue).
- Code Analysis wizard uses cursor-based incremental event fetch + websocket session updates + sequence merge utility. Evidence: [resources/js/Pages/Tools/CodeAnalysis/Wizard.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Pages/Tools/CodeAnalysis/Wizard.vue), [resources/js/Pages/Tools/CodeAnalysis/eventStream.js](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Pages/Tools/CodeAnalysis/eventStream.js).

### 6) Page-Level Orchestration Patterns (Deep Surfaces)
- Jobs form orchestration is highly stateful and backend-aware:
- Supports basic/advanced/natural-language schedule modes.
- Natural-language schedule parsing posts to internal parser endpoint and listens for `.NlParseCompleted` on user private channel.
- Handles confidence/degradation UX paths and parses/normalizes cron-active-hours payloads before submit.
- Evidence: [resources/js/Pages/Agent/Jobs/Partials/JobForm.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Pages/Agent/Jobs/Partials/JobForm.vue), [resources/js/Components/Agent/NlScheduleInput.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Components/Agent/NlScheduleInput.vue), [routes/channels.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/channels.php), [routes/api.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/api.php).
- Discovery wizard acts as an orchestration client for multi-phase backend workflows:
- Composes many focused interrogation components.
- Tracks phase/status/action-busy/provider state and executes a large action matrix (plan/build/provider/cleanup lifecycle).
- Uses realtime updates plus timed polling to avoid stale phase transitions.
- Evidence: [resources/js/Pages/Tools/Discovery/Wizard.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Pages/Tools/Discovery/Wizard.vue), [resources/js/Components/Interrogation](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Components/Interrogation), [routes/api.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/api.php).
- Code Analysis pages split responsibilities:

- Wizard page: single-session timeline/task/report orchestration with optimistic status reconciliation and optional auto-start via query param.
- Evidence: [resources/js/Pages/Tools/CodeAnalysis/Index.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Pages/Tools/CodeAnalysis/Index.vue), [resources/js/Pages/Tools/CodeAnalysis/Wizard.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Pages/Tools/CodeAnalysis/Wizard.vue), [routes/web.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/web.php).
- Messenger tools page is schema-driven:
- Loads connector schema from API and dynamically builds credential form/state.
- Uses parallel overview fetch (`health`, `metrics`, `connectors`, `chat sessions`) and lazy loads selected session messages/actions.
- Uses shared confirm-dialog service for destructive connector disconnect.
- Evidence: [resources/js/Pages/Tools/Messenger/Index.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Pages/Tools/Messenger/Index.vue), [routes/api.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/api.php).
- Memory settings page combines config and live diagnostics:

- Evidence: [resources/js/Pages/Tools/Memory/Settings.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Pages/Tools/Memory/Settings.vue), [routes/channels.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/channels.php), [routes/api.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/api.php).
- Docs pages blend server-rendered payloads and client search behavior:
- Controller injects entries/active entry/filters for initial render.
- Client executes debounced instant search against docs API with `AbortController` and local fallback results.
- TOC is derived from markdown headings client-side for in-page navigation.
- Evidence: [app/Http/Controllers/Docs/DocsPageController.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Controllers/Docs/DocsPageController.php), [resources/js/Pages/Docs/Index.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Pages/Docs/Index.vue), [resources/js/Pages/Docs/Show.vue](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Pages/Docs/Show.vue), [app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Docs/DocsSearchController.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Docs/DocsSearchController.php).

### 7) UI Conventions and Design System Behavior
- The visual system is tokenized with CSS variables and consumed in Tailwind theme extensions, not hardcoded palette classes in components. Evidence: [resources/css/theme.css](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/css/theme.css), [tailwind.config.js](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/tailwind.config.js).

### 8) Backend API Integration Points (Frontend Perspective)
- Primary JSON integration surface is versioned `/agent/api/v1/*` with authenticated mutations/reads and module-specific prefixes (`docs`, `interrogation`, `code-analysis`, `messenger`, `memory`, `org`, `delegation`, `notifications`, `jobs`, `runs`). ### 9) Frontend Testing Surface
- Unit/component tests run in Vitest + jsdom and currently cover key rendering/event utility behavior (HelpHint, StatusCard markdown, code-analysis event stream merge/cursor). Evidence: [vitest.config.js](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/vitest.config.js), [resources/js/Components/__tests__/HelpHint.spec.ts](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Components/__tests__/HelpHint.spec.ts), [resources/js/Components/__tests__/StatusCard.spec.ts](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Components/__tests__/StatusCard.spec.ts), [resources/js/Pages/Tools/CodeAnalysis/__tests__/eventStream.spec.ts](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/resources/js/Pages/Tools/CodeAnalysis/__tests__/eventStream.spec.ts).

### Explicit Assumptions
- Assumption: This analysis describes repository-implemented frontend architecture and contracts, not live production behavior under real traffic.

### Pattern-by-pattern extraction (in depth)

#### 1) Layered architecture with strong domain partitioning
- Convention: framework edges (`routes`, middleware, controllers, requests) are separated from domain/application logic in `app/Support/*`, with async orchestration in `app/Jobs/*`.
- Evidence: versioned API and domain route groups in [routes/api.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/api.php); domain module roots under [app/Support](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support); domain jobs under [app/Jobs](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Jobs).
- Consistency: high at module naming level; most modules follow `Support/<Domain>` plus corresponding jobs/controllers/tests.

#### 2) DI/service-container conventions
- Convention: interface-to-implementation bindings and singletons are registered in providers, then injected into jobs/services/controllers.
- Evidence: bindings/subscriptions/policies/rate-limiters in [app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php); memory and messenger provider composition in [app/Providers/MemoryServiceProvider.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Providers/MemoryServiceProvider.php) and [app/Providers/MessengerServiceProvider.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Providers/MessengerServiceProvider.php).
- Consistency: strong, but not pure (see mixed section for direct `new` usage bypassing container extension points).

#### 3) Strategy + Adapter + Factory as a recurring family
- Interrogation runner abstraction: interface + adapter implementations + factory dispatch by runner type.
- Evidence: [app/Support/Interrogation/Contracts/InterrogationRunnerAdapter.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/Interrogation/Contracts/InterrogationRunnerAdapter.php), [app/Support/Interrogation/Adapters/ClaudeAdapter.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/Interrogation/Adapters/ClaudeAdapter.php), [app/Support/Interrogation/Adapters/CodexAdapter.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/Interrogation/Adapters/CodexAdapter.php), [app/Support/Interrogation/AdapterFactory.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/Interrogation/AdapterFactory.php).
- Org synthesis strategy: strategy interface and multiple deterministic algorithms selected by mode.
- Evidence: [app/Support/Org/Synthesis/SynthesisStrategyInterface.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/Org/Synthesis/SynthesisStrategyInterface.php), [app/Support/Org/Synthesis/MajoritySynthesisStrategy.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/Org/Synthesis/MajoritySynthesisStrategy.php), [app/Support/Org/Synthesis/WeightedSynthesisStrategy.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/Org/Synthesis/WeightedSynthesisStrategy.php), [app/Support/Org/Synthesis/ChairDecidesSynthesisStrategy.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/Org/Synthesis/ChairDecidesSynthesisStrategy.php), [app/Support/Org/OrgCouncilService.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/Org/OrgCouncilService.php).
- Messenger/Task provider adapters and drivers:
- Evidence: [app/Contracts/Messenger/ConnectorAdapterInterface.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Contracts/Messenger/ConnectorAdapterInterface.php), [app/Support/Messenger/Adapters/AbstractConnectorAdapter.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/Messenger/Adapters/AbstractConnectorAdapter.php), [app/Support/Messenger/ConnectorManager.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/Messenger/ConnectorManager.php), [app/Support/TaskProviders/Contracts/TaskManagementProviderDriver.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/TaskProviders/Contracts/TaskManagementProviderDriver.php), [app/Support/TaskProviders/TaskManagementProviderManager.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/TaskProviders/TaskManagementProviderManager.php).
- Memory provider factory:
- Evidence: [app/Support/Memory/MemoryAdapterFactory.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/Memory/MemoryAdapterFactory.php), [app/Support/Memory/MemoryCapabilityResolver.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/Memory/MemoryCapabilityResolver.php).
- Consistency: high pattern recurrence; low-to-medium openness in some managers because supported options are hard-coded (`match`) instead of config/registration-driven extension.

#### 4) Pipeline/orchestrator pattern for complex workflows
- Delegation verification pipeline runs ordered steps, short-circuits on fail, pauses on pending, resumes from checkpoint.
- Evidence: [app/Support/Delegation/VerificationPipeline.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/Delegation/VerificationPipeline.php).
- Docs ingestion pipeline runs staged collection/validation/sort/duplicate detection and fails with aggregated validation errors.
- Evidence: [app/Support/Documentation/DocsIngestionPipeline.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/Documentation/DocsIngestionPipeline.php).
- Memory formation pipeline executes sequential stages with partial-failure semantics and structured result.
- Evidence: [app/Support/Memory/MemoryFormationPipeline.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/Memory/MemoryFormationPipeline.php).
- Consistency: high in intent; mixed implementation style (some pipelines container-injected, others instantiate default steps directly).

#### 5) Event/subscriber pattern as coordination backbone
- Provider-level event subscriber registration.
- Evidence: [app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php).
- Subscribers own coordination/recovery/broadcast responsibilities.
- Evidence: [app/Listeners/DelegationCoordinator.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Listeners/DelegationCoordinator.php), [app/Listeners/DelegationRecoveryHandler.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Listeners/DelegationRecoveryHandler.php), [app/Listeners/DelegationBroadcastSubscriber.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Listeners/DelegationBroadcastSubscriber.php).
- Cross-domain telemetry events are subscriber-handled and queued.
- Evidence: [app/Listeners/Documentation/DocumentationTelemetrySubscriber.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Listeners/Documentation/DocumentationTelemetrySubscriber.php).
- Consistency: high and explicit; strong decoupling of workflow progression from broadcast side effects.

#### 6) State-transition services (atomic transition convention)
- Convention: transitions are done via single conditional UPDATEs enforcing allowed source states.
- Evidence: [app/Support/Delegation/TaskStateTransitionService.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/Delegation/TaskStateTransitionService.php), [app/Support/Delegation/GraphStateTransitionService.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/Delegation/GraphStateTransitionService.php), [app/Support/Interrogation/SessionStateTransitionService.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/Interrogation/SessionStateTransitionService.php), [app/Support/RepoAnalysis/SessionStateTransitionService.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/RepoAnalysis/SessionStateTransitionService.php).
- Consistency: very good; this is one of the clearest cross-domain conventions.

#### 7) Middleware pipeline conventions
- Boot aliases and API-specific exception envelope are centralized.
- Evidence: [bootstrap/app.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/bootstrap/app.php).
- API route chain composes auth, throttles, feature gates, and webhook integrity middleware.
- Evidence: [routes/api.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/api.php), [app/Http/Middleware/Messenger/VerifyWebhookSignature.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Middleware/Messenger/VerifyWebhookSignature.php), [app/Http/Middleware/Memory/MemoryEnabled.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Middleware/Memory/MemoryEnabled.php), [app/Http/Middleware/DelegationFeatureGate.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Middleware/DelegationFeatureGate.php).
- Consistency: high on composition; response semantics vary by middleware/domain (details below).

#### 8) Repo Analysis subsystem uses plugin/registry/task-graph architecture
- Contract: analyzers implement a stable interface and optionally dependencies.
- Evidence: [app/Support/RepoAnalysis/Analyzers/AnalyzerInterface.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/RepoAnalysis/Analyzers/AnalyzerInterface.php), [app/Support/RepoAnalysis/Analyzers/AbstractAnalyzer.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/RepoAnalysis/Analyzers/AbstractAnalyzer.php).
- Registry: profile-based analyzer selection with support checks and skip reasons.
- Evidence: [app/Support/RepoAnalysis/Analyzers/AnalyzerRegistry.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/RepoAnalysis/Analyzers/AnalyzerRegistry.php).
- Task graph: dependency-aware plan generation (`depends_on`) and deterministic task keys.
- Evidence: [app/Support/RepoAnalysis/TaskGraphBuilder.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/RepoAnalysis/TaskGraphBuilder.php).
- Queue orchestration: explicit queue/connection control with misrouting guard.
- Evidence: [app/Support/RepoAnalysis/RepoAnalysisExecutionOrchestrator.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/RepoAnalysis/RepoAnalysisExecutionOrchestrator.php).
- Consistency: high inside the subsystem; good internal architectural coherence.

### Architectural conventions observed
- Versioned API envelope convention: `/agent/api/v1` + `AgentApiVersionHeader` + API-only error envelope rendering in bootstrap.
- Feature-flag gate convention: `FeatureFlagManager` used across middleware and services; managed keys centralized in [app/Support/Agent/FeatureFlagManager.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/Agent/FeatureFlagManager.php).
- Domain queue convention: queue names partitioned by domain (`agent`, `interrogation`, `messenger-*`, `delegation`, `memory-*`, `org-rituals`, `code-analysis`) in [config/horizon.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/config/horizon.php).
- Policy and throttling convention: policies and named rate limiters are registered centrally in [app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php), then applied in [routes/api.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/api.php).

### Where patterns are mixed or violated

| Area | What is mixed/violated | Why it matters | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Route layer vs controller/service boundaries | `routes/web.php` contains heavy closure logic for code-analysis pages (feature checks, authorization, DB query, projection) instead of delegating to controllers/services | Increases routing-layer coupling and makes behavior harder to test/reuse consistently | [routes/web.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/routes/web.php) |
| Messenger layer duplication | Two different `ChatActionPolicyValidator` classes exist in different namespaces with different API and denial semantics | Creates ambiguity of source-of-truth and parallel policy evolution risk | [app/Services/Messenger/ChatActionPolicyValidator.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Services/Messenger/ChatActionPolicyValidator.php), [app/Messenger/Validation/ChatActionPolicyValidator.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Messenger/Validation/ChatActionPolicyValidator.php), [tests/Unit/Messenger/ChatActionPolicyValidatorTest.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/tests/Unit/Messenger/ChatActionPolicyValidatorTest.php), [tests/Unit/Messenger/Validation/ChatActionPolicyValidatorTest.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/tests/Unit/Messenger/Validation/ChatActionPolicyValidatorTest.php) |
| Namespace layering overlap in messenger | `Jobs/Messenger` orchestrate with both `App\Support\Messenger\...` and `App\Services\Messenger\...`, while handlers live under `App\Messenger\...` | Blurs architectural boundaries and increases cognitive load for maintainers | [app/Jobs/Messenger/ProcessInboundMessage.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Jobs/Messenger/ProcessInboundMessage.php), [app/Jobs/Messenger/ProcessChatIntent.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Jobs/Messenger/ProcessChatIntent.php), [app/Services/Messenger/ChatActionExecutor.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Services/Messenger/ChatActionExecutor.php), [app/Messenger/ChatAction/Handlers](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Messenger/ChatAction/Handlers) |
| DI purity drift | Several classes instantiate concrete collaborators directly (`new`) instead of provider/container composition | Reduces replaceability and consistency of DI conventions | [app/Support/Org/OrgCouncilService.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/Org/OrgCouncilService.php), [app/Support/Delegation/VerificationPipeline.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/Delegation/VerificationPipeline.php), [app/Support/RepoAnalysis/Analyzers/AnalyzerRegistry.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Support/RepoAnalysis/Analyzers/AnalyzerRegistry.php), [app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php) |
| Controller thinness is inconsistent | Some API controllers are orchestration-heavy and directly manage transitions/dispatch/query/serialization | Service-layer pattern exists in codebase but is not uniformly applied, leading to mixed style | [app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/AgentJobController.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/AgentJobController.php), [app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/RepoAnalysisSessionController.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/RepoAnalysisSessionController.php) |
| Feature-gate response semantics differ by surface | Similar gate intent returns different statuses (`404`, `403`, `503`) depending on middleware/route/UI | Can complicate client behavior and observability expectations across modules | [app/Http/Middleware/DelegationFeatureGate.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Middleware/DelegationFeatureGate.php), [app/Http/Middleware/DelegationUiFeatureGate.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Middleware/DelegationUiFeatureGate.php), [app/Http/Middleware/OrgFeatureGate.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Middleware/OrgFeatureGate.php), [app/Http/Middleware/OrgUiFeatureGate.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Middleware/OrgUiFeatureGate.php), [app/Http/Middleware/Memory/MemoryEnabled.php](/Users/garethdaine/Code/agent/app/Http/Middleware/Memory/MemoryEnabled.php) |

### Consistency assessment
- Structural consistency: high. Domain modularization and naming conventions are strong and repeated.
- Behavioral consistency: medium-high. Event-driven orchestration and transition services are consistently applied.
- Pattern purity: medium. The codebase intentionally mixes strict layered architecture with pragmatic inline orchestration (route closures, fat controllers, direct `new` in some strategy/pipeline/registry classes).
- Risk concentration from mixed patterns: highest in messenger layering overlap and duplicated policy-validator responsibilities.

### Assumptions and uncertainty
- Assumption: “dominant” is judged by repeated structural evidence across inspected modules, not by runtime traffic frequency.
- Assumption: some direct-instantiation choices may be intentional for deterministic defaults/test ergonomics; classification as “mixed” is architectural, not necessarily a bug.
- Assumption: this analysis is repository-static; no runtime tracing was performed, so coupling/violation impact is inferred from code structure only.

Extract dominant design and architecture patterns with evidence
Identify and document mixed/violated pattern areas

Dominant patterns and conventions documented in depth
Mixed/violated areas clearly identified with evidence

Should the messenger policy validation model be unified to one namespace and one response semantic (generic denial vs descriptive denial)?
